```sql
SELECT 
    e.FirstName, 
    e.LastName, 
    COUNT(*) AS NumberOfCustomers
FROM 
    Employee e
JOIN 
    Customer c ON e.SupportRepId = c.SupportRepId
GROUP BY 
    e.FirstName, e.LastName
```

SELECT year, population + population AS combined_population FROM country_stats GROUP BY iso3, year ORDER BY year;

SELECT gdp_usd, gdp_per_capita_usd, life_expectancy_years, fertility_rate, urban_population_pct, internet_users_pct, unemployment_pct
FROM country_stats
GROUP BY iso3, year
ORDER BY gdp_usd DESC, gdp_per_capita_usd DESC, life_expectancy_years DESC, fertility_rate DESC, urban_population_pct DESC, internet_users_pct DESC, unemployment_pct DESC;
SELECT * FROM country_stats WHERE internet_users_pct < 10 AND internet_users_pct > 50 AND year = 2010 AND year = 2023;
SELECT AVG(flipper_length_mm) AS average_flipper_length FROM penguins;

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM penguins WHERE body_mass_g > (SELECT AVG(body_mass_g) FROM penguins WHERE species = 'male' AND flipper_length_mm > 0 AND bill_depth_mm > 0 AND bill_length_mm > 0 AND sex = 'male' AND year = 2023);

```sql
SELECT singer.Country
FROM singer
WHERE singer.Is_male = 'T'
  AND singer.Age > 40
  AND singer.Is_male = 'F'
  AND singer.Age < 30;
```
